title: Pokémon Developer Game Freak Announces Ame nochi Hare Onna Mobile Game
content:
GAME FREAK Inc. announced on Monday a new mobile game titled Ame nochi Hare Onna ( Girl After the Rain) , which will launch for iOS and Android in Japan this winter. The company revealed the game's teaser promotional video, key visual, and main character and cast members.

Hiyori Kōno will voice the game's main character Himawari Harewatari, a Hare-onna (Sunny Girl) magical girl who transforms the weather into power to brighten people's spirits. Aki Minamino designed the character.

Yuki Nagano will voice Pon Arai, a Tanuki-type (raccoon dog) divine messenger called "Kumorin" that grants power to a Hare-onna magical girl as their partner. Kyōko Abe designed the character.

Mirika Kawa will voice the Hare-onna magical girl Yūri Amanohara, and Ayaka Fujimoto will voice her Kitsune-type (fox) Kumorin partner Kon Oribe.

Chinatsu Hirose will voice the Hare-onna magical girl Izu Shinotsuki, and Momoka Tsuji will voice her Nezumi-type (mouse) Kumorin partner Chuchu Yumekawa.

The game's livestream also introduced the "Machine Sentakki," the mysterious truck that lends its power to the Hare-onna magical girl. GAME FREAK 's Ken Sugimori designed "Machine Sentakki."

The game has the tagline, "Tomorrow's weather will become magic." In the game, real-time weather forecasts across Japan will be integrated, which affects different aspects of the game, giving a different gaming experience every day.

Shigeru Oomori ( Pokémon Pokopia game concept and senior director) is the new game's director and producer, and Katsunori Suginaka is the scenario director. GAME FREAK is collaborating with CHRONOGATE to develop the game.

GAME FREAK is best-known as the developers of the Pokémon franchise games. The studio launched the Beast of Reincarnation game for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, Xbox Cloud, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam on August 4.

title: New Ranma 1/2 Anime's Season 3 Reveals 3rd Promo Video
content:
The staff for the third season in the new anime based on Rumiko Takahashi 's Ranma 1/2 manga revealed the third promotional video for the anime on Monday. The video previews the opening and ending theme songs for the season.

Fumino performs the opening theme song "Sunao Miman" (Below Honesty) and Yuika performs the ending theme song "Kawaikunai" (Not Cute).

New cast members for the third season include:

• Masako Nozawa as Grand Master

• Jun Fukuyama as Sentarō Daimonji

• Mayumi Tanaka as ???

• Saori Hayami as ???

• Minami Tanaka as Tsubasa Kurenai

Seiya of comedy duo Shimofuri Myojo will guest star in the anime in a yet unannounced role and will serve as the promotional ambassador.

Kōnosuke Uda is again directing the anime at MAPPA . The third season will have mainly returning cast and staff members. Returning chief animation directors Yoshiko Saitō and Kōsuke Kawamura will be joined by Riko Kaneda (new anime's first season animation director) and Haruki Miura ( Ensemble Stars! , JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean ). Masahiro Kurio also returns as main animator with the addition of Atsuko Ishida (1989 Ranma ½ key animator) and Yoshihiro Takeda ( The Devil Is a Part-Timer! seasons 2 & 3).

The anime's first season premiered nationwide in Japan in October 2024. The anime exclusively streamed on Netflix after its broadcast.

Kōnosuke Uda ( One Piece: Dead End film, DAYS ) directed the first season at MAPPA . Kimiko Ueno ( Delicious in Dungeon , Astro Note ) was in charge of series scripts, and Hiromi Taniguchi ( Kurage no Shokudō ) designed the characters.

The second season premiered in October 2025 on NTV . The series streamed on Netflix after the television broadcast. Most of the staff from the first season returned for the second season. However, Kōsuke Kawamura joined the staff as one of the chief animation directors, and Ryūta Hayashi joined Chihiro Ōkawa to direct the art.

title: 'Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content:
The official website of the Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. ( Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion ) television anime revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, the main visual (pictured), and promotional video on Monday. The anime series adapting Eiko Mutsuhana 's fantasy romance light novel will air on October 5 at 9.30 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX, BS Nippon TV, and MBS.

Voice actors Hiro Shimono ( Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru ) and Akira Sekine ( Towa no Yuugure ) are joining the cast as Tien Kong and Villaura, respectively.

Staff Art Director: Scott MacDonald ( Tougen Anki ) Art Design: Maho Takahashi ( Maid-san wa Taberu dake ) Color Design: Yuki Hayashi ( Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon ) CG Director: Yudai Takahashi Director of Photography: Hiroaki Asano Editing: Toshihiko Kojima ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ) Music Producer: Shigeru Saitou ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon producer)

Singer-songwritter Centimillimental ( Given ) is performing the opening theme "Kanawanai,," with Rainy. ( Sengoku Youko: Senma Konton-hen ) performing the ending theme "Mada Uso ni Naranai." Both theme songs are previewed in the main promotional video below.

Keizou Kusakawa ( Isekai Yakkyoku ) is helming the anime at Diomedéa . Wataru Watari ( Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu ) is handling the series composition. Masakazu Ishikawa ( Kamonohashi Ron no Kindan Suiri ) is designing the characters, while Hayato Matsumura ( Kimi wa Houkago Insomnia assistant music composer) is composing the music.

Mutsuhana wrote the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website from April 2019 to March 2020. Futabasha published the series under its M Novels f imprint with illustrations by vient in two volumes in October 2019 and March 2020.

Misato Kamada began drawing a manga adaptation on the Flos Comic web magazine in August 2020. The sixth volume went on sale on February 5.

Cross Infinite World licensed the light novel digitally in English and released the second and final volume in January 2021. Yen Press licensed the manga in English and published the fifth volume on January 20.

Main PV

title: Web Manga 'Funsou deshitara Hatta made' Gets TV Anime
content:
Publishing company Kodansha announced a television anime adaptation of Motohiro Den 's Funsou deshitara Hatta made ( If It's a Conflict, Leave it to Hatta ) web manga on Monday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).

Den began serializing the mystery seinen manga in the Morning magazine in November 2019 before transferring it on the D Morning web service in September 2021. Kodansha published the 19th volume on February 20, with the 20th volume scheduled for a September 18 release. Funsou deshitara Hatta made has a cumulative 1.2 million copies of its volume in circulation.

Introduction In a chaotic modern world filled with border disputes, ethnic conflicts, and criminal cartels, geopolitical risk consultant Yuri Hatta travels the globe to resolve various crises. From remote regions steeped in superstition to cutting-edge metropolitan cities, Yuri tackles unpredictable disputes that defy common sense. Relying on her sharp intellect, deep knowledge of geopolitics, and occasional pro-wrestling moves, she uncovers the realities of the world—while exploring local and bizarre cuisines along the way.

Official manga site: https://morning.kodansha.co.jp/c/funsodeshitara.html Official manga X: @ funsodeshitara

title: To You in the Beyond Anime Film Reveals Character Videos
content:
The staff of To You in the Beyond , the anime film of Akiko Abe 's Doko Yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e novel, revealed a compilation of six character promotional videos on Monday.

The recently announced cast members include (from left to right in the image below):

Previously announced cast members include:

Hiiro Ishibashi as the protagonist Kazuki Tsukigase

Anna Nagase as Nao Akishika, a mysterious girl

Simba Tsuchiya as Mikiya Ozaki, Kazuki's classmate

Hiroshi Tamaki as Kōzu, who holds the key to the story

Naohito Fujiki as Nishina, Kazuki Tsukigase's homeroom teacher who watches over him

The film will open in Japan on October 9. (Production companies Shochiku and Pony Canyon report that "international release details" will be announced later.)

The novel's story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

Musician Tota performs the opening theme song titled "Olive."

Junichi Wada ( HIGH CARD ) is directing the anime at TMS Entertainment , and Sayaka Kuwamura ( Strobe Edge , Josee, The Tiger and the Fish ) wrote the screenplay. Hechima ( Cosmic Princess Kaguya! ) is serving as character designer and chief animation director. Kōji Nakamura is composing the music. Shochiku is distributing the film.

Abe and Shueisha released the book in October 2017, with art by syo5 .

Haruka Chino launched a manga adaptation of the novel on Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump website in August 2025. Shueisha released the manga's first compiled book volume on February 19.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eight Ending Featuring "CYCLE" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eight ending, featuring the song “CYCLE” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 90-101, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the seventh ending, featuring the song “Ameato” performed by W-inds . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Previews Opening Theme in 2nd Promo Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's The Ramparts of Ice ( Koori no Jyōheki or Ice Castle Wall ) manga began streaming a second promotional video on Monday for the anime's second season . The video previews four-piece band THE BEAT GARDEN 's opening theme song "Escort."

The second season will premiere on October 1. The new season will again air on Thursdays at 11:56 p.m. (10:56 a.m. EDT) on TBS and 27 affiliated channels. It will also stream on Netflix , as well as other services in Japan.

The manga centers on Koyuki Hikawa, an aloof high school student who has a hard time getting close to others, and who builds a wall between herself and other people. Although she spends her time alone at school, for some reason Minato Amemiya keeps getting closer to her. The frustrating story of youth follows the lives of four somewhat complicated individuals: Koyuki and Minato, plus the popular girl Miki and the laid-back boy Yōta.

The cast includes:

• Anna Nagase as Koyuki Hikawa

• Fūka Izumi as Miki Azumi

• Shōya Chiba as Minato Amamiya

• Satoshi Inomata as Yota Hino

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Tsubasa Igarashi

• Sakura Shinfuku as Tsukiko Shimojima

• Akari Kitō as Momoka Kuriki

• Kakeru Hatano as Yūki Azumi

• Natsumi Kawaida as Akine Atagawa

Mankyū ( Pui Pui Molcar the Movie: MOLMAX , Sumikkogurashi – Good to be in the corner , The IDOLM@STER Shiny Colors ) is directing the anime at Studio KAI . Yasuhiro Nakanishi ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War , Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun , Mecha-Ude: Mechanical Arms ) is in charge of the series scripts. Miki Ogino ( Osana Najimi no Carbou ) is designing the characters. Kanade Sakuma and Natsumi Tabuchi are composing the music.

The first season premiered on TBS and 27 affiliated channels on April 2 at 11:56 p.m. in Japan. The season then debuted globally on Netflix on April 2, and it is also streaming on other services in Japan.

Agasawa ( You and I Are Polar Opposites ) originally serialized the manga as a webtoon on the LINE Manga app from January 2020 to April 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 14th and final compiled volume (reorganized for volume format) in February 2025.

The manga ranked at #15 for male readers in the 2024 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2023, and also was nominated for the 69th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2023. The manga placed second in May 2024 in the "Vertical Scroll Comic" section of the second Rakuten Kobo E-book Awards. Additionally, the manga ranked #2 on AnimeJapan's sixth "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll in 2023.
author: ANN

title: Motohiro Den's Funsō Deshitara Hatta made Geopolitical Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
The official website of Kodansha 's Morning magazine announced on Monday that Motohiro Den 's Funsō Deshitara Hatta made (If It's a Conflict, Leave it to Hatta) manga will get a television anime adaptation. More details will be revealed at a later date.

The manga centers on Yuri Hatta, who works as a geopolitical risk consultant. Hatta takes on cases from different parts of the world and tries to solve them using her geopolitical intellect and some bold tactics.

Den launched the manga in Morning magazine and on its official app "D Morning" in November 2019. D Morning currently serializes the manga. Kodansha published the manga's first compiled book volume in March 2020, and will publish the 20th volume on September 18.

title: New Sgt. Frog TV Anime's 2nd Main Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, 5 New Cast
content:
The staff for Keroro Gunsō ☆ , an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime , started streaming the anime's second main trailer, and revealed five new cast members on Monday. The trailer reveals and previews the opening theme song "Kirai nochi Suki!" (From Hate to Love!) by ano , and the ending theme song "Himitsu no Panorama" (Secret Panorama) by PURPLE BUBBLE .

The newly announced cast members are (image above from top left to bottom right):

• Yuki Sakakihara as Fuyuki Hinata

• Minori Fujidera as Natsumi Hinata

• Sumire Morohoshi as Momoka Nishizawa

• Hiiro Ishibashi as Mutsumi Hōjō

• Koko Fukushima as Koyuki Azumaya

The anime will debut on October 3 at 9:30 a.m., and will air on TV Tokyo and its affiliates.

The anime will feature an all-new cast for the franchise . The previous Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! film that opened in June featured a returning cast from previous installments in the anime.

The previously announced new cast includes:

• Kōsuke Echigoya as Sergeant Major Kululu

• Rika Nagae as Private Second Class Tamama

• Makoto Koichi as Sergeant Keroro

• Toshiki Masuda as Corporal Giroro

• Satoshi Inomata as Lance Corporal Dororo

Nobuhiro Kondō ( Shōnen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan four seasons, Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens , Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ ) is the chief director of the anime, and Akihiko Sano ( Farmagia , animation director for Medaka Box ) is directing the series at BN Pictures with production cooperation by Bridge and AISLE . Toshimitsu Takeuchi ( Shōnen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan four seasons, Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens , Fairy Musketeers ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Hatsue Nakayama ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ ) is designing the characters. Kan Sawada ( Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! , Yowamushi Pedal anime franchise ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Color Design: Keiichi Funada

• Art Director: Kenichi Tajiri, Shintarō Inoue

• Director of Photography: Teruyuki Kawase

• Editing: Daisuke Imai

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! (New Sgt. Frog the Movie: The Earth Is in Mortal Peril as Soon as We Come Back!), the new 20th anniversary anime film project for the franchise , opened in Japan on June 26. The film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend, earning 150,809,200 yen (about US$927,900) in its first three days.

Crunchyroll added the earlier television anime to its catalog beginning in 2021, and it describes the anime:

Keroro is Sergeant Frog - the leader of a platoon of warriors sent to conquer planet Earth. But when the amphibious invaders discovered how much humans enjoy dissecting their comrades, the troops were scattered, the mission was aborted, and Keroro was abandoned. Now, this once proud soldier spends more time wielding a vacuum than he does the weapons of war. It's a far cry from the glory of battle, but hey, at least he's got his own room. And though the invasion may have slowed to a hop, Sergeant Frog still occasionally yearns to overcome his karaoke addiction and reassemble his troops.

Sunrise 's earlier anime series based on Mine Yoshizaki 's Sgt. Frog ( Keroro Gunsō ) manga ran from 2004 to 2011, and it spawned five feature films. Funimation released two "seasons" of the anime on DVD, after ADV Films had licensed but not released the anime.

Discotek licensed the anime, and its release of Sgt. Frog includes all 358 episodes in successive SD Blu-ray Disc volume releases by season, beginning in 2021. Discotek released seasons 5-7 in 2024.

American manga publisher Tokyopop released 20 volumes of the original manga in North America before shutting its doors in 2011.
author: ANN

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Special New Animation by KONAMI Released for Kazuki Takahashi Art Exhibition
content:
A new Yu-Gi-Oh! special animation has been released to commemorate KAZUKI TAKAHASHI: YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS , the first original art exhibition dedicated to series creator Kazuki Takahashi.

The short animation brings Yugi and other familiar characters together in Domino City, with Blue-Eyes White Dragon also appearing alongside Seto Kaiba. Eri Osada directed the animation, with Hiroko Utsumi handling the storyboard. Takahiro Kagami served as character designer and 2D drawing director, while Haruka Taira was art director. KONAMI animation handled the animation production.

ALSO READ: An Interview With the Legendary Kenjiro Tsuda: Yu-Gi-Oh! 25th Anniversary at Anime NYC 2025

The project was created by the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime series production committee as part of celebration for the 30th anniversary of the original manga’s serialization.

KAZUKI TAKAHASHI: YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS will run from December 12, 2026 until February 21, 2027 at Creative Museum Tokyo in Japan. The exhibition will showcase original artwork by Kazuki Takahashi and marks the 30th anniversary of Yu-Gi-Oh! , which began serialization in 1996. It also has an official English information page for international visitors.

Kazuki Takahashi launched Yu-Gi-Oh! in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump in 1996, with the manga running until 2004 and being collected in 38 volumes. The series went on to inspire multiple anime adaptations. Takahashi died in 2022 at the age of 60. The story follows Yugi Muto, who solves an ancient Egyptian puzzle known as the Millennium Puzzle, which unleashes the spirit of a mysterious Pharaoh. They then have all kinds of card battles and other games to protect their friends and uncover the mystery behind Pharaoh’s lost memories.

The franchise has since become an iconic trading card game ( Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG/OCG ), multiple anime series (including Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters , GX , 5D’s , ZEXAL , ARC-V , and more), video games, and movies. In related news, a remaster of the anime Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Monsters GX was also recently announced for April 2025.
author: Anime Corner
